# ============================================================
#  gMSA_settings.txt
#  Edit this file to change service/task/timing settings.
#  Do NOT edit the main script - all non-query config lives here.
# ============================================================

# --- gMSA SOURCE ---
# auto   = detect gMSA from the service named in gMSA_ServiceName
# manual = use the value in gMSA_Manual
$gMSA_Source = "auto"

# --- SERVICE NAME (used when gMSA_Source = auto) ---
$gMSA_ServiceName = "SHDelegator"

# --- gMSA MANUAL OVERRIDE (used when gMSA_Source = manual) ---
# Format: DOMAIN\accountname$
$gMSA_Manual = "states\t0_gMSA_SHSA$"

# --- DC TARGET (optional) ---
# Leave blank to let AD auto-select a DC.
# Set to a hostname or FQDN to force the query to that DC.
# Example: "DC01.states.local"
$DC_Target = ""

# --- TASK SETTINGS ---
$TaskName  = "TestgMSAPermissions"
$SleepSecs = 10
